_doc: Config for tools/build_anims.py. When a clip's mp4 lands in Downloads, set its 'file' to the exact filename (the runner also accepts a 'match' glob) and run: python tools/build_anims.py. Slots are relative to game/assets. Defaults: fps 12, height 700; drop to fps 8 / height 560 if a slot exceeds ~7MB. After a build, run the Godot editor import pass so the PNGs import.
